featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wanted to visit some good places where I can try a variety of juice and shakes so I visited the craufet market, so I tried searching for some famous stalls or places for food/juice for which I got to know that "Pappu Juice wala" is pretty famous on Mohammad Ali Road. I saw the pictures and decided to visit.

So the stall is at the main road itself, you will easily locate it via Google map. So they provide juice and shakes according to season, currently strawberry is the main fruit. The cost of juice/shakes is very economical you can try it in the range of Rs50-Rs200 all the juices.

They use fresh fruits and everything, they cut the fruits right in front of you. The only thing I did not like was the hygiene. So just next to the stall they have a dustbin where you can throw you cutleries and everything and they throw the residue of the fruits. So, this dustbin attracts lots of flies and other insects. At the same time due to too many crowds they keep cutting the fruit continuously for the juice and shakes but they do not cover it with anything, so the fruit pieces are open and the shop is on the road and they have a dustbin as well next to the stall. So I will definitely recommend them to change this.

Talking about the shakes you shall definitely try the strawberry 🍓 cream shake, they use fresh strawberry and cream it is recommended.
Whereas you can also try coconut cream shake, they serve it in the coconut shell. I am not much of a fan of 🥥 coconut thus I did not like it, but my friends love it. so you shall definitely try that too. It's an all season thing.

Rest I am sharing the photos which you can see and judge accordingly.

featured_reviews.name: Himanshu Gajbhiye
featured_reviews.review_text:
A very popular fruit juice corner. Their most unique serving is the cream of fruit juices like watermelon cream, coconut cream, mango cream etc.
In that, they first prepare a normal juice of that fruit. Take it out in a fancy hollow coconut/container. Pour the juice in it.
And then they spread amul fresh cream all over it , further garnishing it with dry fruits.
The dish thus prepared is so unique that one might not have tasted it for sure ever. It also is so damn tasty that it will surely make you give another visit.

featured_reviews.name: Aatmi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Patil Juice Centre is originally known for its great variety of fresh juices, and milkshakes but now also serves fast food like sandwiches, pizzas, and garlic bread, with Jain options available 🌱 The place is quite popular and often crowded, with barely any seating outside, so you may have to wait for your order to be prepared. The Jain Veg Cheese Grill Sandwich 🥪 was tasty, well-filled, and nicely grilled, making it a satisfying snack. Overall, a good spot for fresh juices and quick bites.

featured_reviews.name: Asmant Nimbalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: They have good combination juices, named after Bollywood. The taste was good, but I think it was not worth the price. Service was good and fast.

featured_reviews.name: Aastha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried the Fresh Strawberry Cream at Patil Juice Center, and it was absolutely delightful! The strawberries tasted fresh and juicy, perfectly paired with the rich, creamy texture. It was refreshing, not overly sweet, and made for the perfect indulgent treat. The quality and freshness really stood out, making it easy to see why it's such a popular choice. Definitely a must-try for strawberry lovers.

I usually go to the other one but that was closed the day I went to recently, so had to visit this place. This a 4* place but that is a 5* one. It's fulfilling and costs around 150 to 300 depending on your choice.

featured_reviews.name: Sarvesh Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
We tried the Mango Berry Juice, and it was absolutely wonderful. The quality felt top-notch—fresh, rich, and full of flavor. At ₹230, it did feel a bit overpriced for the quantity, but the taste and quality make up for it.

There’s no seating available, so the place can feel a bit congested with all the rush. However, they do serve drinks directly to your car, which makes it a great option if you’re on a drive.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much for your detailed and thoughtful review! We're delighted to hear you loved the Mango Berry Juice and appreciated its freshness and flavor. 😊

We understand your point about the pricing and seating — and truly appreciate your honest feedback. Our goal is always to offer great quality, and it's heartening to know that reflected in your experience.

Glad you found our car service convenient too! We hope to keep improving and look forward to serving you again soon. 🍹🚗💛

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered a plate of batata bhajiya  from this Juce centre, and to be very honest, it was one of the worst food experiences I've had in a long time.

🔴 Taste: The fritters were stale, oily, and had a very unpleasant aftertaste. It was clear the ingredients used were not fresh, and the oil may have been reused multiple times.

⚠️ Hygiene & Health: Just a few hours after eating, I started suffering from severe diarrhoea, which made it clear that the food was unhygienic or contaminated. This is a serious health concern, and no customer should have to go through this.

❌ Overall Experience:

Very poor quality food

Risk to health and safety

🙏 I strongly urge the restaurant management to take this feedback seriously and improve the food quality and hygiene standards.

I genuinely hope no other customer faces such a terrible and painful experience like I did.

⭐ Rating: 1/5

This is one of the sobos best veg and jain restaurant. My jain friends visit this restaurant too often and they love the food out here. Even i came here for the 3rd time in a row. As soon as I came to know they introduced some new items on the menu, I went there to try it .

Apart from these we tried their cheesy pao bhaji, cheese burst pizza which melted our hearts , hummus platter , and spicy panner burger . We loved everything.
Drinks were also on point eena meena deeka which was a combination drink .
It was really good to see that they keep on introducing new items on the menu . Will keep visiting for such more often .

featured_reviews.review_text: “Juice Time is truly a hidden gem in South Mumbai for pure veg & Jain food lovers! 🌟 Open till late night, the menu has so much variety with fresh flavors, quick service, and great quality. Perfect spot for family dinners, midnight cravings, and even small celebrations with their spacious party area. Highly recommended for anyone looking for tasty vegetarian food with a great vibe! 💚”

featured_reviews.name: suraj pagare (Sam on demand)
featured_reviews.review_text: For vegetarians this place is just amazing, Absolutely loved this restaurant! The food is delicious with an amazing variety of dishes to choose from. Every item we tried was full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The dessert section is equally impressive with so many tempting options. The ambiance is great, and the service was warm and attentive. A perfect spot for food lovers – highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Ridham Porwal
featured_reviews.review_text: Food that speaks for itself, drinks that impress, and an ambience you’ll want to stay in all night. Every dish was a perfect balance of flavor and presentation. Definitely a place worth coming back to.”

featured_reviews.name: Dhananjay Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an absolutely terrible experience at Juice Time. The customer service was beyond disappointing — the staff were rude, inattentive, and acted like they were doing me a favor by even acknowledging my order. There was zero professionalism and no basic courtesy.

The food was just as bad. What I received was poorly prepared, tasted awful, and honestly felt unhygienic. It’s shocking how low the quality was, especially considering how simple the menu is.

What made it worse was the overall attitude — no accountability, no apology, and no effort to improve the situation. It’s one thing to serve bad food, but combining that with such disgusting service makes it a place I would strongly advise everyone to avoid.

Definitely one of the worst experiences I’ve had. Never ordering from here again.

featured_reviews.name: Pavan J
featured_reviews.review_text:
Juice Time - a genuinely disappointing experience.
The staff came across as rude and completely lacking basic hospitality. What made it worse was the poor handling by the manager, who added no value in resolving the situation.
Their furniture ended up spoiling my shirt, yet there was no proper apology, accountability, or compensation offered.
A place can only improve when the good for nothing manager is fired or changed

featured_reviews.name: Aadil Rakhangi
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited this place late evening. Ambience is very very good. Nice place to chill with friends. Had ordered Pita Bread with Hammus. Followed by Pasta. Taste was very good. For cold drink tried the Mulberry Juice. It was again very nice. Overall experience was very nice. Helpful staff. Good service. Definitely would recommend one to visit this place.

featured_reviews.name: The Wandering Veggie
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered Falafel Shawarma 🥙, Pasta pe Pasta and Firangi (Peru+Strawberry) Juice 🍹

The Falafel Shawarma  was lovely, hummus, pickled beetroot, other veggies, falafels, everything was perfect.

The Firangi juice had more peru(guava) taste than strawberry, but was fresh and not too sugary. Will definitely try other curious combos the next time.

Pasta pe Pasta was a combination of macaroni in cheesy sauce and speghetti in red sauce, taste was pretty good, the breads served with it were a little dry.

Staff was very nice and let us use the group seating area which could easily accommodate 9-10 people although we were just 2. The ambience is pretty good.

If you advance book through Zomato Gold Dining option and then pay through Zomato Gold, you get flat 15% off on total bill which is a steal deal.

1. Paneer Baby Corn Roll:
The roll are tasty delicious and more over soo healthy. They are barbequed to give us immense flavours

2. Melting hot chilli sandwich:
We all must have tried the other variant of this (Melting Cheese Sandwich) but those who love that extra spice in there sandwiches they must try this one😋

3. Paprika cheese rice :
Loved this sooo much . The rice was soo flavourful and it had soo many vegetables in it . A must try if u like cheesy flavour 🤤

4 . Panner momos and Schezwan momos:
Trust me they are super delicious. Their chutney is just perfect to blend with the scrumptious Momos. Must try!!
.
.
This place has total 9 branches in Charni Road, Lower Parel, Parel, Mazgaon, Ghatkopar East, Malad West, Kandivali West, Vashi and Hyderabad
.
.
They have a crazy variety of pizza, pasta, sandwhiches, BBQ Charcoal Rolls, Chinese, Frankies, Pav Bhaji, Tawa Tempt, Momos, Pot Rice, Maggie, Fries, Starters etc. They have all items available in Jain.

They undertake outdoor events, weddings, parties and corporate orders.

Here i tried some new items as follows

It was damn delicious and yumm.It was quite huge and sufficient for one person to have .
.
2.Peri Peri Sandwich -
If you are a peri peri lover then must try this sandwich,it includes peri peri sauce,cheese,black olives, corn, chopped paneer, capsicum etc
Totally worth to have .
.

They were just mouthwatering as it was cheese loaded momos and they had given 3 different sauces with mayonese ,it I really felt so good to have it.
.

featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
5 Stars for the Food
1 Star for the Pricing

I generally try not to give low ratings to businesses and prefer to give them the benefit of the doubt whenever possible.

However, fairness in reviewing also means pointing out issues when they arise.

Amar Juice Centre has long been a popular spot opposite Girgaon Chowpatty for quick snacks and street-style dishes. I’ve visited here multiple times over the years and have generally enjoyed the food.

On this visit, I ordered the Dahi Puri, which as always was excellent. The flavours were well balanced, the puris were crisp, and the overall taste was exactly what one expects from a good Mumbai chaat spot. In terms of quality, taste, and preparation, the food easily deserves five stars.

However, the pricing is where the experience becomes difficult to justify. The last time I visited, around 2024, the Dahi Puri was roughly ₹90. On this visit it was priced around ₹180 before taxes. That represents nearly a 100% increase in a relatively short period of time.

While some increase due to inflation is understandable, such a steep jump in pricing over roughly a year or two feels excessive from the perspective of a regular customer. Inflation sits generally at 5% a year not 50% a year!!

So while the food and service remain very good, and pretty much exactly as it was 2 years ago, the pricing makes the overall value difficult to justify.

Food & Service: ★★★★★
Pricing / Value: ★☆☆☆☆

Overall rating: ★★☆☆☆

The grape blossom was a rich blend of thick grape juice and ice cream scooped on the top.
Blossom usually contains icecream blended in but we requested in on the top.

Strawberry milkshake was amazing. The original taste of strawberry was preserved. It was thick to enjoy with lots of strawberry pieces.

Pineapple blossom was a nice pineapple juice with vanilla ice cream scooped on the top

Our total came to around Rs 260. It's a good juice spot. I have tried others in the area but this is definitely better.

featured_reviews.name: Sarang Vakharia
featured_reviews.review_text: Highly recommend ppl to visit, best fresh natural juice, no mixing, i recommend 4 berry juice. Its my every weekend spot

featured_reviews.name: Chandresh Vk
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is at Kalbadevi just next to Edward theatre. The variety of juices, shake and cream item is good. After dinner it's preferable to visit specially, although its open more then 10 hrs a day. My favourite is mint lime sweat and salty very light and tasty apart there are many good option available. Try it 👍

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Sane
featured_reviews.review_text: It's another great juice centre in the area. The juices and shakes are moderately priced. The mint lemon cooler is a personal favourite. It's extremely refreshing. Another one is the Oreo shake, a dallop of ice cream can be added on to the Oreo shake.

featured_reviews.name: Mustafa Vakil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best juice in Mumbai
Specially 4 berries juice

featured_reviews.name: Yahya Baker
featured_reviews.review_text: Great juice and milkshake place. A wide variety of options are available on the menu. And their chocolate variants....MUAH! Amazing taste! Tho the sweetness might be much for people who take less sugar and sweet stuff in their diet. Otherwise, great place. Only two wheeler parking as it's located on a busy road.

featured_reviews.name: mustansir rangwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Natural juice centre is not natural they load their juices and milkshakes with sugar . Heaps of sugar are put into your drinks which would make your juice or milkshake sweet and if it's sweet you have to like it.

I had ordered Nutella Milkshake was ok expected it to be sweet and was fair as per the drink and I ordered plain chocolate milkshake specifying no added sugar still it turned out to be super sweet and after arguing the juice maker admitted that he had put sugar in it plus loads of chocolate syrup making it even worst.

The owner was rude and il mannered. when I told him about the sweetness he refused to take the feedback and straight away dipped his finger into my glass to taste while i was carrying the glass. He refused to accept that the quantity of the sugar was more masking the taste of the drink. After arguing in front of his other customers he admitted and gave another milkshake without sugar which was little better.

Request people to stay away from these artificial scam making juice centre stating being natural they are just here to make money and don't care for peoples health.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Chinikamwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of the best juice parlours in sobo .
The owner is super friendly and the quality and price for juice is just amazing . We are regular visitors to this place and would recommend you try the lemon mint soda and the 2 berry blossom

featured_reviews.review_text: A one stop shop for everything Jain and an array of Indian sweets. A fan of their methi theplas (10pcs for 160/-) and their gujarati snacks. Freshness is the norm here and variety is the name of the game. You may also order ahead.

featured_reviews.name: Yashika Thakkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
A great place for typical Indian Chinese food. I tried their veg crispy and triple Schezwan rice with Manchurian gravy, and everything was really tasty and satisfying.
The flavors are exactly what you expect from good Indian Chinese. Another big plus is that the place is open till 2 AM, making it perfect for late-night food cravings.
Definitely worth visiting if you love Indian Chinese cuisine!

featured_reviews.name: CA Mohit Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Had Bamboo Rice, Manchow Soup and Jain French Fries with family. Food was delicious and tasty. Highly recommend for regular and jain cuisine.

featured_reviews.name: Mansi Javiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai Bites is always a delight! We visit every time we're at Girgaon Chowpatty. Their Paneer 65 and Potato Crispy are absolute favorites - timeless classics! Great experience every time.

Service could be faster, but the food is totally worth the wait! Staff is attentive.

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Sheth Food blogger
featured_reviews.review_text: We absolutely loved their sandwich. And the chaupal rice is something really amazing which one must try. 😋and it's not over cheese lovers it's for you, cheese corn toast is just to die for. Don't forget they also have something for paneer lovers - Barbeque grill sandwich absolutely loaded with paneer. It's a budget friendly outlet. They have 3 outlets in Mumbai 2 in SOBO and another one in matunga. Do try ordering from swiggy or zomato . They have recently startes with juices and dessert can't wait to try that as well😋😋

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
🤩🤩🤩🤩 I ordered Melting Pizza it cost us above 200 size was 9 inches

the taste was ordinary i didn't find any special ingrediants as it didn't seem to be melting pizza i rated 4 star as the atmosphere was good and taste was nice for other item.

We order veg crispy as well and the quantity wqs good enough for two people.

😋 it too cost us above 200

No water is provided. You need to buy water bottles 👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻 Need improvement in this. 🙂

Staff was not on their toes all the time they were in kitchen and we need ti catch their attention to order anything.

Only go if you have patience as cooking takes alot if time as they serve fresh food 😊

featured_reviews.name: Prachiraj Shrivastava
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai Bites in Girgaon is a great spot if you love tasty street-style food with a clean and comfortable vibe. The menu has a lot of options—from classic chaats and sandwiches to Indo-Chinese and quick snacks—so it’s perfect whether you want a light bite or a full meal.

The food is flavourful, especially their pav dishes, fries, and shakes. Portion sizes are good for the price, and the presentation feels fresh. The staff is friendly and the service is fairly quick, even during busy hours. The place is small but nicely maintained, making it a good hangout spot with friends.

Overall, Mumbai Bites Girgaon gives a fun and satisfying café experience at reasonable rates.

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Jadeja
featured_reviews.review_text: No seating option available. Only plastic tables to seat on the footpath. Cheese chilli toast was just bland to taste & average experience. The melting cheese sandwich was something worth trying. The blossom shakes here are value for money.

featured_reviews.name: About every Damnthing
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visit this once and you will make this place as your adda thats for sure!
.
What all I had ?
1) Pahadi grill cheese sandwich - Very huge grill cheese sandwich with two chutneys and very tasty sandwich. Beautifully presented and was very tasty plus not too costly as well! Considering girgaon and sobo its way too affordable as well!
.
2) freyo tower - Their freyo tower starts from ₹150/- can you just believe that. Plus on top you get 3 options cheese corn balls, fries and nachos and in drinks you can choose mocktails, shakes or juices! I will recommend you to try this out for sure!
.
3) Gravy Khichiya - The best khichiya because not the ones u get from stalls or streets but the gravy can make u full easily and very tasty as well, very unique and highly recommended.
.
4) Aloo chilly - Paneer chilly sab jagah milta he try their aloo chillly omg its cery tasty and you will definitely love this as much as u love paneer chilly . A better alternative to those who are vegan.
.
Must visit this place, rates are affordable taste is amazing and hygiene is maintained.
